partnershipPlan: Two ICU survivors from the follow-up clinic review the plain-language summary; a bedside nurse educator reviews the eligibility rules.

items.quote: Composite paraphrase: I could not lift a cup when I left intensive care, and nobody had told me that might happen.
items.implication: Report weakness as a patient-centred outcome.

items.quote: Composite paraphrase: At night, with one nurse to two patients, I am not sitting someone up with three lines in.
items.implication: Record day and time of missed mobilisation.

items.quote: Composite paraphrase: The day she sat in the chair was the day we believed she would come home.
items.implication: Include families' views in the summary.

items.quote: Composite paraphrase: I want the extra bed-days number for the budget meeting.
items.implication: Keep the ICU-days analysis descriptive and separate from causal claims.

summary: Four composite voices on weakness, safety at night, family hope and budget pressure.
